keyFindings.description: A regression from round 1's dedupe fix: fanoutDelivery records the attempt (delivery.go:938) and, on Resolve's Skipped for a consumer session, recordDedupe (delivery.go:973), and the worker's servePortSkip records dedupe (serve_port_workers.go:249). None of them pushes. The relay's judgeFollowedTopic then sees the key Seen and acks a message the port never got. This happens whenever another interest on the topic sends the message down the durable path, a stale interest row of a dead session included. The deep review reproduced it in 1 of 3 runs with a natural race.

roleForwardCopyDelivery still tests entry.Delivery == DeliveryConsumer, so a role-forward copy stored below the holder's consumer start is acked without a push. The stored-only forward already told the sender it was delivered. Use takesStoredMessagesItself(entry, message.storedSeq()); reproduced by the deep review with the below-start test on a role-forward copy.

A seeded resume naming a stream the listener no longer has: the listener starts the consumer at the stream's end, and answered() tells stream_recreated only when resumePoint() is set, which a seeded session's is not, while consumer mode stops the replay engine's own detection. On main the core path told stream_recreated; here the loss is silent.

With the nil branches gone, the worker wiring of main.go:904-910 is copied into test harnesses (main_test.go:3699-3705, dispatch_resolution_test.go:146-153), and withRoleForwards exists because each worker copies the config by value. One wireDeliveryWorkers(cfg) helper used by main.go and the harnesses removes both.
relayed: true is a constant; derive it from the answer or drop it, and call m.relay.registered directly.
replay.setConsumerMode(false) never changes anything (close() already sets it); refollow is now only setFollowed. pi-envoy writes the ledger mode directly too; the module should be its one writer.
The envoy_sessions machine filter and its comment are copied in pi-envoy (envoy.ts:4346); move it into @legion/envoy-client.
fanoutRefusalOutcome's err parameter is never read; targetedMode wraps a (string, error) pair with no logic; sessionRelays.sessions duplicates rules.sessions.
persist? is optional, but every caller passes it; the topic-reaches-subject check is written twice (:389, :410-412).
